market_summary: The pre-market setup is cautious to risk-off, based on 1518 articles from Yahoo Finance, Investing.com, Seeking Alpha, Reuters, TradingView. The dominant theme is macro, with 658 macro items, 440 company items, 370 industry items, and 50 policy items. The tape looks more useful for identifying near-term rotation and risk appetite than for making a single directional index call.
macro_summary: Late Cycle Slowdown Markets are balancing easier policy expectations against growth and earnings risk, keeping leadership narrow and confirmation dependent. The market is taking its direction from oil/energy, with investors testing whether policy support can offset slower growth and earnings risk. Macro coverage is concentrated around Fed/rates (141), inflation (100), oil/energy (95), growth/jobs (73). The practical implication is that equity rallies may need confirmation from rates and inflation expectations; if yields rise while growth headlines weaken, risk appetite can fade quickly.
risk_summary: Sentiment is cautious to risk-off: 169 positive, 242 negative, and 1107 neutral articles. My read is to avoid treating headline volume as conviction by itself; the more important signal is whether macro-sensitive and technology-sensitive stories are pointing in the same direction.
